fields.label: Month
fields.description: First day of the month this driver value applies to.

fields.label: Basis
fields.description: head_count: the amount is calculated from this cost centre's share of the driver. amount: the amount is entered directly, and is carved out of the pool before the calculation.

fields.label: Head Count / Driver
fields.description: Head count / leads count / whatever the rule's driver is.

fields.label: Amount
fields.description: Entered directly for a cost centre that has no head count. Carved out of the pool before the remainder is spread.

fields.label: Budget Amount
fields.description: Budgeted allocation for this cost centre and month. Entered by hand and never derived: the budget for an allocation is a decision, not a calculation, and re-deriving it from the actual driver would produce a figure nobody agreed to. Shown beside the derived actual so the two can be compared.

fields.label: Manual Pool
fields.description: Only read when the rule's pool source is manual. Entered once per month; the value on any one row of that month is used.

fields.label: Source
fields.description: How this value arrived. 'reconstructed' means it was rebuilt from dated history after the fact rather than captured at the time.

fields.label: Captured Value
fields.description: What the capture counted. Kept even when overridden, so the difference stays visible.

fields.label: Manually Overridden
fields.description: Set when a human changed the value after a capture. Captures never overwrite it.

fields.label: Frozen
fields.description: A closed month. Re-running capture compares against it and reports drift instead of rewriting it.

fields.label: Evidence
fields.description: The employees or leads counted, snapshotted at capture time. Snapshotted rather than re-queried so the list always reconciles to the number, even after a transfer or a deletion.
